<!-- SPECLET START -->
This project uses speclet for spec-driven development.

Key speclet files:
- Project context: `.speclet/context.md` — read this first on every speclet task
- Ground rules: `.speclet/constitution.md` — read if present and filled in (no `<!-- speclet:unfilled -->` marker)
- Architecture map: `.speclet/architecture.md` — read when implementing features that touch existing modules (if present)
- Plan files: `.speclet/plans/` — original feature plans
- Task index: `.speclet/tasks/index.md` — the phase map, always use this to find phase files
- Phase tasks: `.speclet/tasks/phase-N-*.md` — one file per phase, load only what you need
<!-- SPECLET END -->
